column3: `práti` – práti (invariable; LP) ‖ `stómebhiḥ` – stóma- (nominal stem; INS.M.PL) ‖ `uṣásam` – uṣás- (nominal stem; ACC.F.SG) ‖ `vásiṣṭhāḥ` – vásiṣṭha- (nominal stem; NOM.M.PL.SUP)
`gīrbhíḥ` – gír- ~ gīr- (nominal stem; INS.F.PL) ‖ `víprāsaḥ` – vípra- (nominal stem; NOM.M.PL) ‖ `prathamā́ḥ` – prathamá- (nominal stem; NOM.M.PL) ‖ `abudhran` – √budh- (root; PL.3.IND.AOR.MED)
`vivartáyantīm` – √vr̥t- (root; ACC.F.SG.PRS.ACT.PTCP.CAUS.LP) ‖ `rájasī` – rájas- (nominal stem; ACC.N.DU) ‖ `sámante` – sámanta- (nominal stem; ACC.N.DU)
`āviṣkr̥ṇvatī́m` – √kr̥- (root; ACC.F.SG.PRS.ACT.PTCP) ‖ `bhúvanāni` – bhúvana- (nominal stem; ACC.N.PL) ‖ `víśvā` – víśva- (nominal stem; ACC.N.PL)

`eṣā́` – eṣá (pronoun; NOM.F.SG) ‖ `syā́` – syá- ~ tyá- (pronoun; NOM.F.SG) ‖ `návyam` – návya- (nominal stem; ACC.N.SG) ‖ `ā́yuḥ` – ā́yus- (nominal stem; ACC.N.SG) ‖ `dádhānā` – √dhā- 1 (root; NOM.F.SG.PRS.MED.PTCP)

`gūḍhvī́` – √guh- (root; CVB) ‖ `támaḥ` – támas- (nominal stem; ACC.N.SG) ‖ `jyótiṣā` – jyótis- (nominal stem; INS.N.SG) ‖ `uṣā́ḥ` – uṣás- (nominal stem; NOM.F.SG) ‖ `abodhi` – √budh- (root; SG.3.IND.AOR.PASS)
`ágre` – ágra- (nominal stem; LOC.N.SG) ‖ `eti` – √i- 1 (root; SG.3.IND.PRS.ACT) ‖ `yuvatíḥ` – yuvatí- (nominal stem; NOM.F.SG) ‖ `áhrayāṇā` – áhrayāṇa- (nominal stem; NOM.F.SG)

`prá` – prá (invariable; LP) ‖ `acikitat` – √cit- (root; SG.3.IND.AOR.ACT) ‖ `sū́ryam` – sū́rya- (nominal stem; ACC.M.SG) ‖ `yajñám` – yajñá- (nominal stem; ACC.M.SG) ‖ `agním` – agní- (nominal stem; ACC.M.SG)
`áśvāvatīḥ` – áśvāvant- (nominal stem; NOM.F.PL) ‖ `gómatīḥ` – gómant- (nominal stem; NOM.F.PL) ‖ `naḥ` – ahám (pronoun; DAT.PL) ‖ `uṣā́saḥ` – uṣás- (nominal stem; NOM.F.PL)
`vīrávatīḥ` – vīrávant- (nominal stem; NOM.F.PL) ‖ `sádam` – sádam (invariable) ‖ `uchantu` – √vas- 1 (root; PL.3.IMP.PRS.ACT) ‖ `bhadrā́ḥ` – bhadrá- (nominal stem; NOM.F.PL)
`ghr̥tám` – ghr̥tá- (nominal stem; ACC.N.SG) ‖ `dúhānāḥ` – √duh- (root; NOM.F.PL.PRS.MED.PTCP) ‖ `viśvátas` – viśvátas (invariable) ‖ `prápītāḥ` – √pī- 1 (root; NOM.F.PL.PTCP-ta.LP)
`yūyám` – tvám (pronoun; NOM.PL) ‖ `pāta` – √pā- 1 (root; PL.2.IMP.PRS.ACT) ‖ `svastíbhiḥ` – svastí- (nominal stem; INS.PL) ‖ `sádā` – sádā (invariable) ‖ `naḥ` – ahám (pronoun; ACC.PL)
